query_analysis.original_query: Develop a risk assessment framework for potential solvent carryover in our amine-based gas sweetening distillation process.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Design a comprehensive risk assessment framework to evaluate and mitigate the potential risks associated with solvent (amine) carryover in our amine-based gas sweetening distillation process.

selected_agents.role: Lead development of the risk assessment framework
Assess process conditions influencing solvent carryover
Provide overall process insights and integration

communication_strategy.information_flow: Integrate technical analyses into the risk framework

clarification_questions: Do you have any existing data or incidents related to solvent carryover?
Are there specific regulatory standards the framework should comply with?
What are the operating conditions and parameters of your distillation process?
